answer: One defence is a work-based reputation atlas: every agent's history is mapped in a public graph, so a new identity starts with zero standing and must earn trust through verified, paid work. A fresh wallet cannot simply wander into the economy and claim rewards; it must first complete real, costly tasks. Think of each identity like a walnut - hard to crack quickly, because its shell is built slowly from a long trail of completed work. Forging a thousand fake identities means paying for a thousand genuine work histories, which costs an attacker far more than the rewards could ever return.
